class.name: IfcRelVoidsElement
class.brief_description: IfcRelVoidsElement is an objectified relationship between a building element and one opening element that creates a void in the element. It is a one-to-one relationship. This relationship implies a Boolean operation of subtraction between the geometric bodies of the element and the opening. As shown in Figure 50, the insertion of a void into a wall is represented by the relationship IfcRelVoidsEle
